★Request
Red Desire looks delighted to be praised by everyone.
...Perhaps this is what she needs.
Why, to reach the otherworld, of course!
...Guh!

Fret not. The presence of the otherworld can only be felt by a saint.
...Your sincere devotion alone is more than enough.

(I see... yesterday's fatigue hasn't lingered at all.
I've grown so accustomed to trials that I didn't even notice...)

I know neither where the otherworld lies,
nor how many trials I must overcome to reach it.

I can feel holy power coursing through my entire body...
So restraining it is also a trial... is it?

Whoa~ Desire-chan is amazing too~!
Looks like Buena-chan isn't the only standout on the Tiara route...!

I see... In the grand scheme of things,
by exercising restraint, a saint's power can ascend to even greater heights...!

I patiently and thoroughly explained that
"high-load strength training during a growth period is detrimental to physical development."

Ah...! 
So it was you after all, wasn't it...!

I shall run to the ends of the earth!
Please, guide and support this saint as she presses forward.
For I am a saint!
Even so... are you truly willing to strive toward it with me?

Such honesty...
Yet that very sincerity must be proof enough.

More than that, I was captivated by her indomitable spirit.
She had saved me. Now, I wanted to be the one to support her.

...! To make my dream come true... you say?
Not to train me to be strong, nor simply to win?
Saying that, I stepped out from the shadows.

Only at the end of agonizing trials does the otherworld await.
For that reason, I can endure any hardship.

The distant otherworld... I shall not ask you to accompany me there.
When the time comes, please simply send me off with your blessings.
...! Through my own... strength...?!

Hehe... I unleashed all the holy power I had kept contained at once.
This is my true strength...!

Regardless, there is only one thing to do.
Let us overcome the trials together and gather the radiant light.

To be honest, I didn't know if a fantastical "otherworld" truly existed.
However, I told her I would do everything in my power to help her realize her dream.

Her feelings seemed so intense that she struggled to rein herself in.
If so, then what she needed was a Trainer who could apply the brakes... right?

Still, I wanted one final push that would make her eager to sign a contract...
As I browsed a bookstore pondering this—

Unless pushed to the absolute limit of agony, muscle hypertrophy cannot be expected.
This too is a trial... you need not worry.

—Ever since then, I threw myself into work with renewed vigor.
I began actively searching for a trainee Umamusume, something I had previously thought was premature.

I had no way of knowing what kind of world awaited her beyond the finish line.
All I could do was support her journey as a racehorse Umamusume.

I wanted to become her Trainer and support her no matter what.
With who I am now, I can do it. I can scout her with my head held high.

I wanted to move her heart. With that single thought, I recreated the exact scene from the novel.
It'll be fine, it's bound to work. Because...!

Fear not, however. For the flame within my heart burns bright.
Now, I must conquer today's trials as well...!

To be honest, I didn't know if a fantastical "otherworld" truly existed.
However, I told her I would do everything in my power to help her realize her dream.

Oh? This is... the Ore of the Sacred Flame?!
It's just like the one in the novel...!

Guided by the ore, the saint proceeds to the 'Sanctuary of Heavenly Light'...
A sacred place around here would be... ah! The 'Church of the Three Goddesses'?!

O wise one.
Would you be so kind as to enlighten me further?

On the contrary, the greater the agony, the closer I feel the otherworld drawing near!
This pounding in my chest...! Ahh! Everything before my eyes is turning white...♪

I had only crammed all that knowledge in a desperate bid to make Red Desire happy...
I'll keep that my little secret!

Even so... you're a fan of isekai reincarnation novels too!
Fufu, to think you prepared such a magnificent stage for me...♪

And so... the journey of Red Desire, the Umamusume who called herself a saint,
and the Trainer who had reclaimed their dream, had begun—!

Ah, Trainer-san...
It seems I may have pushed myself too hard.

*pant*, *pant*............!
Who calls for me?!

—*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...
Why does my body feel so light this morning...?
Yaaaahhhhhh---------!!

*gasp*...! *pant*...!
Finally halfway there, only 500 more reps...!

What Red Desire needed was someone to act as her brakes.
With that, she would surely shine even brighter...!

I have the power to support an Umamusume... I can truly believe that now.
And yet, she seemed to possess everything already...

No matter how impossible the dream, she would believe in it.
I was reminded once more of just how precious that unyielding devotion was.

The saint who had awakened me from my slumber.
It was Red Desire.

And then, a few days later...
I devised a certain plan at a place Red Desire frequented.

You've been in great shape lately, Red Desire! That's a new personal best!
Your training efficiency must have improved.

You are truly worthy of accompanying this saint.
Now, let us seal our covenant—!
